data.notes: June 2026 in New York is anchored by Governors Ball, major arena pop/R&B/Latin/electronic dates, and a dense Pride-weekend run of queer and electronic festivals.

events.title: Governors Ball Music Festival 2026
events.summary: New York’s flagship multi-day pop, hip-hop, rock, and electronic festival returns to Queens with headliners Lorde, Stray Kids, and A$AP Rocky. The announced lineup also includes Baby Keem, Kali Uchis, Jennie, Major Lazer, Blood Orange, Clipse, and many more.

events.title: Black Coffee: Pacha New York Opening Weekend
events.summary: Black Coffee headlines the second night of Pacha New York’s opening weekend. The June 21 event is an official opening-weekend booking from 8:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

events.title: LadyLand Festival 2026
events.summary: LadyLand returns for NYC Pride Weekend with Kim Petras, Romy DJ set, CupcakKe, DJ Gigola, Hannah Diamond, BAYLI, and more. The queer festival takes over Under the K Bridge Park across multiple stages.

events.title: Martin Garrix: AMERICAS TOUR
events.summary: Martin Garrix plays a three-night Barclays Center run as part of his AMERICAS TOUR. The June 11–13 booking is one of the biggest electronic music arena runs in the city this month.

events.title: Michael Bibi: Pacha New York Opening Weekend
events.summary: Michael Bibi headlines Pacha New York’s opening weekend on June 20. The official listing bills the night as deep house and driving club music from 10:00 PM to 4:00 AM.

events.title: Planet Pride 2026
events.summary: Planet Pride makes its Pacha New York premiere as a 12-hour, multi-stage Pride event. The announced lineup includes Loud Luxury, Don Diablo, Acraze, Ines Rau, Ty Sunderland, and more.

events.title: Dreamland: Pride in Central Park with Purple Disco Machine + Kungs + Dani Brasil
events.venueName: Capital One City Parks Foundation SummerStage, Central Park
events.summary: Dreamland: Pride in Central Park returns to SummerStage for NYC Pride Sunday with Purple Disco Machine, Kungs, and Dani Brasil. The official listing runs from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM at Central Park.

events.title: FUNCTION XXVII // 5th Anniversary
events.summary: FUNCTION NYC marks its 5th anniversary with a three-room expanded-space activation, a major Brooklyn underground techno/house night with a long-format 23:00–15:00 run.

events.title: MERGE THIS WAY (PRIDE)
events.summary: MERGE’s Pride edition brings a heavy queer techno/house lineup including Boris b2b Volvox, Phase Fatale, Lea Occhi, Juana, Roi Perez, Rachel Noon and more for an all-night-to-day session.

events.title: SummerStage Opening Night: Ledisi for Dinah + José James + Spilata + DJ Kultured Child
events.venueName: Capital One City Parks Foundation SummerStage, Central Park
events.summary: SummerStage’s 40th anniversary season opens in Central Park with Ledisi for Dinah, José James, Spilata, and DJ Kultured Child. The free program centers jazz and R&B voices across generations.

events.title: BASEMENT Pride Weekend: Volvox & Dominga / AMORAL / Mos / Massimiliano Pagliara / Lauren Flax
events.summary: BASEMENT’s Pride weekend blowout centers NYC techno figures Volvox, Lauren Flax, Mos and Sterling Juan Diaz alongside international guests across BASEMENT and STUDIO.

events.title: Planet Pride
events.summary: A large-scale Pride circuit and house party at Pacha New York featuring Don Diablo, ACRAZE, Loud Luxury, Inès Rau, Ty Sunderland and more across multiple stages.

events.title: BRIC Celebrate Brooklyn! Opening Night: Sheila E. + Leon Knight + DJ Spinna
events.summary: BRIC Celebrate Brooklyn! opens its 2026 season at the Lena Horne Bandshell with Sheila E., Leon Knight, and DJ Spinna. The free outdoor series is one of Brooklyn’s signature summer music institutions.

events.title: ALL DAY I DREAM
events.summary: Lee Burridge’s melodic/deep-house institution lands outdoors at Industry City with Rodriguez Jr., Guy Mantzur, Double Touch and Raw Main for a day-into-night open-air session.

events.title: X-TRA.SERVICES: Kaiser / Ma Haiping / Antenes / Faustin / LYDO / Connor Wrong
events.summary: X-TRA.SERVICES brings pure and hypnotic techno to BASEMENT with Kaiser, Ma Haiping, Antenes, Faustin, LYDO and Connor Wrong.

events.title: FIST: DJ T-1000 / Sevyn 0000 / DJ Warning / Mother Daughter Dance / DJ Shannon
events.summary: FIST returns to BASEMENT with Detroit-born techno veteran DJ T-1000, Sevyn 0000, Word of Command, DJ Clone, DJ Warning, Mother Daughter Dance and DJ Shannon.

events.title: Summer Walker: Still Finally Over It Tour
events.summary: Summer Walker brings the Still Finally Over It Tour to Brooklyn with Monaleo and Odeal. This is one of the month’s major R&B arena dates in New York.

events.title: Pure Honey Pride: Mike Q, Kevin Aviance, David Elimelech
events.summary: House of Yes and No Vista’s Pure Honey Pride centers queer and trans nightlife with ballroom/club royalty Mike Q, Kevin Aviance, David Elimelech, D3NIM and Ash B.

events.title: Carín León: De Sonora Para El Mundo
events.summary: Carín León brings the De Sonora Para El Mundo Tour to Barclays Center on Friday, June 5. The booking adds a major Latin arena show to New York’s June calendar.

events.title: Joji: SOLARIS Tour
events.summary: Joji brings the SOLARIS tour to Barclays Center with Nate Sib and Corbin. The June 26 arena show is one of the month’s major alternative pop and R&B-leaning concerts in Brooklyn.
